background: NatWest Group is the holding company of the UK's largest business bank, owner of NatWest, Royal Bank of Scotland, Ulster Bank and Coutts, returned to full private ownership after its financial-crisis rescue.
synthesis: Rated A on average across all three, the weakest at A-, all on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 10 Sep 2025; the holding company sits below its operating banks. Capital is on the weak side of UK majors, with CET1 of 13.5% and leverage of 4.6% below the peer median, and since 30 Sep 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.7 points, leverage 0.4 points and LCR 11 points. LCR of 137% is in the bottom quarter while NSFR of 131% is above the median. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
